item.title: Lionesses lose out at Saltdean
item.description: Millwall Lionesses were beaten 2-0 at Saltdean United on Sunday afternoon. A goal in each half was the undoing of Ted Jones' side, who were also reduced to 10 women midway through the second-half. The Lionesses will look to get back to winning ways as they host Brentford on Sunday 15th March. Millwall: Deans, Jones, Joyce, Watling, Helt, Squirrell, Seely, Brooks-Hughes, Richards, Throp, Abu. item.title: Wes in action as Argyle beat Doncaster
item.description: Wes Harding played 66 minutes last weekend as Plymouth Argyle defeated Doncaster Rovers 2-1 in Sky Bet League One. item.title: Farewell, Adrian Wisson
item.description: Millwall Football Club would like to wish Adrian Wisson all the very best as he departs The Den after a lengthy and storied career with The Lions. Adrian, a Millwall fan from birth, started his working life with the club working in the media team, writing for the matchday programme, before adding his dulcet tones to matchday commentary and eventually becoming Millwall's kit man for many years, working over 750 games in the process. item.title: Club Statement: Charge for breach of FA Rule E21
item.description: Millwall Football Club acknowledges the decision by The Football Association to impose upon it a £45,000 fine and an extension to the FA Action Plan, following a breach of FA Rule E21 during the Carabao Cup fixture against Crystal Palace on Tuesday 16th September 2025. The sanctions have been imposed in relation to the use of a chant containing the phrase 'South London Spastics'.
